Inputs.SubtitleText: JEROME ELLIOT: Help! Let me out of here! I'm not supposed to be in quarantine. Those things are everywhere!

Inputs.message: Post Hardware Lobby Visit Scripting Activated!
Dahl's operator detected you. Fireteam response imminent

Inputs.SubtitleText: It's over Randolf. I know about everything. The hospital in Senegal. The fraud. All the harm you've caused. Harm that you made me a part of. I'm going to give you one chance to come clean.
Meet me in the comm room and we can contact the authorities on Earth. Confess for your family. Confess and maybe we can start to fix this.
